narr: A stationary front across Rhode Island and southeast Massachusetts provided the focus for heavy rain and scattered thunderstorms. Four to six inches of rain fell in the greater Providence area, with a max of 7.44 inches in Rehoboth, MA.
ev: In East Providence, at 310 PM EDT (210 EST) flash flooding caused the blockage of all travel lanes on Interstate 195 westbound at Exit 2. At 323 PM EDT (225 PM EST), a car was reportedly stuck in flood waters on Roma Street. At 402 PM EDT (302 PM EST), Broadway was completely flooded between Juniper and Laura Streets. Also in East Providence, at 520 PM EDT (420 PM EST), Waterman Avenue was flooded and impassable.
In Central Falls, a car was stuck in flash flooding on Higginson Avenue. Water was reportedly up to some peoples' knees.
